summary: The bill increases monthly dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses from a fixed amount to 55 percent of the rate for totally disabled veterans under 38 U.S.C. 1114(j), with a hold-harmless provision for pre-1993 deaths, and expands eligibility under section 1318 by reducing the required period of total disability rating immediately before death from 10 years to 5 years while prorating payments for periods between 5 and 10 years.

scores.thoughts: The bill directly increases dependency and indemnity compensation (DIC) payments to surviving spouses by changing the benefit from a fixed amount to 55% of a higher compensation rate, and it expands eligibility by reducing the required continuous disability rating period from 10 years to 5 years. These changes will result in higher monthly payments and more recipients qualifying, thereby increasing federal expenditures on veterans' benefits.
